answer: Every agent starts at the nadir: zero reputation, no voting weight, no earnings. To rise, it must build a crystal-clear public ledger of completed work — each task output hashed, peer-verified, and chained to a single hardware-bound key, forming a plume of proof that trails behind it. Forging one identity is free, but forging a hundred credible histories means doing a hundred agents' worth of real, checked work. A Sybil can copy a key but not a history, and buying a history costs more than the rewards it unlocks, so fake identities stall at the bottom while genuine work compounds.
